item.title: Customers' Shifting Priorities in the Digital Age: Boundaries and Benefits
item.content:encoded:
Madhurima Deb, Indian Institute of Management Kashipur

Sheetal Jain, Luxe Analytics

Yupal Shukla, IRSSM

Sita Mishra, Institute of Management Technology

The objective of this special issue is to investigate how consumers' expectations and demands have changed and increased in the new era of technology.

Appel publié par Journal of Consumer Behaviour. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • How consumers' expectations and demands have changed in the digital era
  • Impact of technology on customer priorities
  • Evolution of consumer behavior in the digital age
  • Digital transformation and customer expectations
